engineering_note: Engineering output; no biological or scientific validation is implied.

units.basis: source unit nm; converted to Å by MDAnalysis (convert_units=True)

frame_identity.note: format stores no per-frame atom identity; fixed atom order is assumed (fixed-topology contract)

precision.nominal_source_resolution: lossy compression; precision set by the writer (commonly 0.001 nm = 0.01 Å); not read by this adapter
precision.note: float64 output does not restore precision lost in the source or the reader

npz_arrays.coordinates_angstrom: (frames, residues, 3) float64, Å, NaN if absent
npz_arrays.time_ps: (frames,) float64, NaN if not provided by the format
npz_arrays.chain/resid/icode/label: (residues,) per output residue; resid -1 if absent
